item.description:
# Weft 1.1.23
- Deliver agent approval requests to a persistent review inbox, with project and checkout badges, macOS notifications, recipe diffs, and Approve or Deny actions. - Return request IDs to CLI and MCP clients and support waiting for a decision, including after an approved checkout removal. - Allow claim holders to approve narrowly scoped checkout recipe changes using committed package scripts, with an audit trail and Revert in Weft. - Keep claims and releases working when a preview service has changed, and include updated preview mappings in recipe review. - Support explicit checkout paths and per-project folder templates; avoid tracking the base branch when creating a branch. - Surface failed services during automatic recovery and support Cursor's authenticated local HTTP transport when its stdio sandbox blocks the local socket.
